architecture.one_pass_only: C4 v2 is a one-pass pipeline. Iterative retrieval is OUTSIDE PRIMARY C4.
pipeline: BM25 + BGE CANDIDATE RETRIEVAL (P2 RRF, frozen)
architecture.runtime_purity: No oracle metadata may enter runtime. _oracle_metadata, proof_edges, required_evidence_ids, answer_node, family, entity_regime, and evaluator canonical entity are evaluator-only.

C4_1.description: C4-0 + subject-preserving information state + frozen improved follow-up query formulation

C4_3.description: C4-2 + I3 identity-record resolution + canonicalized state update

C4_4.description: C4-3 + deterministic S2c structure+relation selection + deterministic packet ordering
C4_4.determinism_guarantee: Same task + same candidate pool + same identity + same config always produces same selected evidence + same order + same packet hash
C4_4.deterministic_fallback: if identity_status in {EXACT, RESOLVED}: selector = S2c; else: selector = S0

C4_5.description: same real query/retrieval/identity candidate pool + oracle selector

C4_6.constraint: may bypass retrieval because it is the reader/evidence ceiling

certification.rule: Never trust analysis.json because it is present. Every derived metric is recomputed from raw receipts and compared; any mismatch beyond tolerance sets VALID_RUN = false.
certification.valid_run_rule: VALID_RUN = conjunction of every derived gate. No gate may be asserted as a literal; each is a function over the artifacts. A gate that cannot be evaluated FAILS.

determinism_requirements.packet_ordering_authority: packet_ordering_policy.canonical_sort_key is the sole definition of packet order. No other section may restate it.
determinism_requirements.pass_criterion: 120/120 identical packet hashes across all runs
determinism_requirements.rule: Every intermediate collection entering S2c must have a canonical ordering, and every ranking must define a total order.

order: 1. chain score descending (quantized to 12 decimal places)
selector_tie_break_policy.scope: The SELECTOR's ranking over candidate chains. This is not the packet order; see packet_ordering_policy.canonical_sort_key.

diagnostic_arms.isolation_rule: DIAGNOSTIC arms explain C4_4. They must not enter the primary seven-arm ladder, the arm-count completeness gate, the promotion threshold, or any gap-capture formula. They do not become tuning candidates unless a new protocol version explicitly opens them.
diagnostic_arms.purpose: Complete the membership x ordering 2x2 so Q(C4_4) - Q(C4_3) decomposes into ordering, membership and interaction.

evaluator_provenance.fail_closed: If source hash does not match manifest, FAIL CLOSED. Do not silently continue.
evaluator_provenance.rule: Every evaluator output must declare its exact input via cryptographic hash binding.
evaluator_provenance.would_have_caught: Two different C4-4 raw files sharing byte-identical evaluator-v2 outputs

abort_conditions: prompt binding violated (packet.prompt_hash != generated prompt hash)
receipt missing a declared packet boundary hash
determinism receipt did not compare every claimed field
derived metric disagrees with recomputation from raw receipts
fail_closed_runner.valid_run_status: VALID_RUN=true only if every prerequisite passed

goal: Determine whether the independently qualified query, retrieval, identity-resolution, and structural-selection mechanisms compose into a materially better end-to-end HRM memory pipeline without oracle information at runtime, with deterministic reproducibility and cryptographic provenance.

iterative_retrieval_status.may_reconnect_when: Runtime bridge predictor shows positive utility in controlled experiments
iterative_retrieval_status.reason: Oracle bridge strongly improves evidence acquisition, but runtime bridge inference failed qualification. Therefore second pass is withheld from primary C4.

lineage.affected_prior_results: Results labelled C4_4 under v2 measured S2c membership under pool order (the C4_4m cell). They remain valid measurements of membership and are reclassified, not voided. See RESEARCH_STATUS.json historical_development_signal.
lineage.conformance_defect_repaired: Under v2 the deterministic packet order was computed and hashed but the runner recomposed the HRM prompt from selection.selected_ids, so the ordering policy never reached the model. v2_1 requires the prompt to be built from the ordered packet and requires packet.prompt_hash to equal the prompt hash the model actually consumed.
lineage.reason: resolve contradictory packet ordering specification and bind actual prompt-order semantics

membership_vs_ordering.separation: Membership selection (which records survive) and packet ordering (in what sequence HRM receives them) are distinct stages.

quality.note: Binary correctness stored separately. Never overload quality with accuracy.

packet_hashing.purpose: Clear boundaries for debugging: retrieval changed? membership changed? ordering changed? prompt changed?

canonical_sort_key: 2. retrieval fusion score descending (quantized to 12 decimal places)
packet_ordering_policy.no_two_records_compare_equal: record_id is unique within a packet, so rule 3 makes the key a strict total order regardless of score ties.
packet_ordering_policy.note: This is NOT claimed to be optimal. It is explicit, versioned, testable, and deterministic. Ordering is measured as a separate ablation via C4_3o and C4_4m.
packet_ordering_policy.other_arms_use: retrieval pool order as emitted by the selector

selector_score_excluded.reason: S2c scores CHAINS, not records: _score_chain is a property of a path, a record may appear in many chains, and records enter the packet by greedy chain packing plus pool-order backfill. There is no per-record selector score to order by. Projecting the chain score onto records would be a new mechanism, not the exposure of an existing quantity, so selector score is removed from packet ordering rather than manufactured.
selector_score_excluded.where_selector_scores_do_apply: The selector's own total order over chains, defined in hrm_adaptive_memory.retrieval_bench.selectors.chain (_pack_chains, candidate_sort_key). That is a distinct ordering at a distinct granularity and is not packet ordering.

pre_hrm_freeze.architecture: PRE-HRM FREEZE -> immutable packets -> HRM generation
pre_hrm_freeze.prompt_binding_rule: HRM must generate from the prompt composed over the ORDERED packet. packet.prompt_hash is computed pre-HRM from that text and must equal the prompt hash recorded for the generation. A mismatch aborts the task.
pre_hrm_freeze.purpose: If HRM results change later, you can prove whether the input changed.
pre_hrm_freeze.rule: HRM stage consumes frozen packets. It does not rerun retrieval or selection internally.

primary_question: Do the independently qualified mechanisms compose into a useful, non-oracle RETRIEVE action, reproducibly?

promotion_gates.D1_determinism: 0 packet differences across repeated processes. PASS required.
promotion_gates.D2_provenance: Every evaluator artifact cryptographically references its exact raw source. PASS required.
promotion_gates.D3_metric_correctness: Golden tests verify all quality and gap formulas. PASS required.
promotion_gates.D4_mechanism_gain: On untouched evaluation: Q(C4_4) - Q(C4_0) > 0 with predeclared statistical threshold.
promotion_gates.D5_no_family_regression: Require family-level reporting. No catastrophic collapse in any important family.
promotion_gates.D6_canonical_identity_safety: False canonical resolution = 0 or strict predeclared threshold.
promotion_gates.D7_artifact_integrity: Every file in run manifest matches its hash.
promotion_gates.D8_clean_release: All tests pass, clean git tree, expected commit, expected protocol hash, expected dependencies.

supersedes_reason: v2 specified packet ordering twice, inconsistently: determinism_requirements.tie_break_policy put selector score before role priority, while packet_ordering_policy.within_role_tier put role tier first. Reproducibility cannot be certified against an internally inconsistent contract. v2_1 defines exactly one packet order and scopes the selector's own total order separately.
